description:
Replace borrowed credibility and broad claims with direct Jido adoption evidence.

Exit criteria:
- At least three detailed, qualified Jido case studies are public.
- Existing showcase entries state their real Jido relationship.
- Performance and time claims have methods or are absent.
- Community faults feed tests and documentation.
- At least one case study shows how a real team identifies, constrains, observes, and investigates Agent work.
- Security and compliance language does not exceed the reviewed evidence.

Backlog tasks: 28

Source: Jido Site Improvement Backlog 2026-07-23.md

comments.text: Achievable deliverables done: case-study template (T01/T02), showcase submission template (T09), benchmark methodology (T17/T18/T19). Residual is categorically external: real production case studies and measured benchmarks require real Jido deployments that do not yet exist; these templates define what qualifies as evidence so future submissions are bounded.

title: E11 — Add community and production evidence
